name: Alidoro
dsc: Alidoro's 'The Gothamist' sandwich is a masterpiece of Italian deli craftsmanship. This 4-pack kit features premium prosciutto paired with creamy burrata cheese on freshly baked artisan bread. The prosciutto is thinly sliced and melts in your mouth, while the burrata adds a luxurious, creamy texture that perfectly complements the savory meat. Each sandwich is finished with a drizzle of high-quality olive oil and a sprinkle of sea salt. Alidoro is a New York City institution known for its authentic Italian sandwiches.

name: Central Grocery Muffulettas
dsc: Central Grocery's Original Muffuletta is a New Orleans icon that has been delighting customers since 1906. This 2-pack includes two massive sandwiches made with a round Sicilian sesame bread, layered with cured meats, provolone cheese, and their famous olive salad. The olive salad is the star of the sandwich, adding a tangy, briny flavor that perfectly balances the richness of the meats and cheese. Each sandwich serves 3-4 people, making this pack perfect for small gatherings.

name: Sal, Kris & Charlie's Deli
dsc: Sal, Kris & Charlie's Deli in Astoria, Queens is famous for 'The Bomb,' a massive sandwich that lives up to its name. This pack serves 4 people and includes their legendary sandwich piled high with ham, salami, pepperoni, provolone, and fresh toppings on a hero roll. The sandwich is so large that it's often shared among friends and family. This deli has been a New York favorite for decades, known for its generous portions and high-quality ingredients.

name: Primanti Bros.
dsc: Primanti Bros. is a Pittsburgh institution known for its iconic sandwiches piled high with meat, melted cheese, and coleslaw, all served between two slices of thick Italian bread. This party pack allows you to choose your favorite meat, including pastrami, corned beef, or capicola. Each sandwich is a hearty meal that captures the essence of Pittsburgh's working-class food culture. Primanti Bros. has been serving these legendary sandwiches since 1933.

name: Ugly Drum
dsc: Ugly Drum from Los Angeles offers a unique twist on barbecue with their 'Ugly Buns' Burnt End Sandwich Kit. This 6-pack features their famous burnt ends, which are the caramelized, flavorful pieces from the point of the brisket. The burnt ends are slow-smoked over a custom wood blend, creating a rich, smoky flavor. Served on soft buns with pickles and onions, these sandwiches are a favorite among BBQ enthusiasts. Ugly Drum is known for its bold, authentic flavors.

name: Town Hall Deli
dsc: Town Hall Deli in South Orange, New Jersey is famous for its Sloppy Joe sandwich, which is not to be confused with the loose meat version. This sandwich features layers of corned beef, pastrami, and turkey with coleslaw and Russian dressing on rye bread. It's a New Jersey classic that has been a favorite since the deli opened in 1925. This sandwich feeds 3 people and is packed with flavor and texture.

name: Alidoro
dsc: Alidoro's Best Sellers 4-Pack features their most popular Italian sandwiches. This pack includes a variety of combinations featuring premium Italian meats like prosciutto, soppressata, and mortadella, paired with fresh mozzarella and flavorful condiments. Each sandwich is made on artisan bread and is a perfect representation of authentic Italian deli style. Alidoro has been serving New York City since 1983 and is a favorite among Italian food lovers.

name: Central Grocery Muffulettas
dsc: Central Grocery's 3-pack of Original Muffuletta sandwiches is perfect for larger gatherings, serving 10-12 people. Each sandwich features their signature round Sicilian bread loaded with Genoa salami, ham, provolone cheese, and their famous olive salad. The olive salad, made with olives, celery, garlic, and spices, adds a unique briny flavor that has made this sandwich a New Orleans legend since 1906. This pack is ideal for parties and celebrations.

name: Tommy DiNic's
dsc: Tommy DiNic's is a Philadelphia landmark known for its legendary roast pork sandwiches. This 4-pack kit features their famous slow-roasted pork, which is seasoned with garlic and herbs, then roasted until tender and juicy. The pork is piled high on a soft roll and topped with sharp provolone cheese and bitter broccoli rabe. This sandwich has been named one of the best in America and is a must-try for any sandwich lover visiting Philadelphia.

name: Junior's Cheesecake
dsc: Junior's Cheesecake is famous for its desserts, but they also offer this incredible Reuben sandwich kit. This 4-6 serving kit includes corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and Russian dressing on rye bread. The corned beef is tender and flavorful, the sauerkraut adds a tangy crunch, and the Russian dressing ties everything together. Junior's has been a Brooklyn institution since 1950, and this sandwich kit brings their deli expertise to your home.

name: Buona Italian Beef
dsc: Buona Italian Beef is a Chicago institution that has been serving authentic Italian beef sandwiches since 1981. This 8-pack kit includes their famous slow-roasted beef, which is sliced thin and piled high on Italian bread, then dipped in savory au jus. The beef is perfectly seasoned with garlic, oregano, and other Italian spices. This kit also includes giardiniera and sweet peppers for added flavor. A true Chicago classic for any gathering.

name: Campo's Philly Cheesesteaks
dsc: Campo's Philly Cheesesteaks has been a Philadelphia favorite since 1947. This combo 4-pack includes two cheesesteaks and two Italian hoagies, offering the best of both worlds. The cheesesteaks are made with thinly sliced ribeye steak and melted provolone cheese on a fresh hoagie roll, while the Italian hoagies feature a variety of premium meats and cheeses. Campo's is known for its high-quality ingredients and authentic Philly flavors.

name: Philippe The Original French Dip
dsc: Philippe The Original French Dip is a Los Angeles landmark that has been serving its famous sandwiches since 1918. This 6-pack features their legendary French dip sandwich, made with tender roast beef piled high on a fresh French roll, served with a side of rich au jus for dipping. The beef is perfectly seasoned and slow-roasted to perfection. This sandwich is a true LA classic that has been enjoyed by generations of Angelenos.

name: Anderson's Frozen Custard
dsc: Beef on Weck is a Buffalo, New York specialty that has been enjoyed since the 1800s. Anderson's Frozen Custard offers this 4-pack kit featuring thinly sliced roast beef piled high on a kummelweck roll, which is a hard roll topped with coarse salt and caraway seeds. The beef is tender and flavorful, and the roll adds a unique crunch. Anderson's has been serving Buffalo since 1946 and is known for its classic beef on weck.

name: Sunrise Biscuit Kitchen
dsc: Sunrise Biscuit Kitchen in Chapel Hill, North Carolina is famous for its fried chicken biscuits. This kit includes everything you need to create their legendary breakfast sandwiches at home. The chicken is crispy, juicy, and perfectly seasoned, while the biscuits are soft, flaky, and buttery. This kit also includes honey butter that adds a sweet and savory finish. Sunrise has been a Southern favorite since 1978, serving some of the best biscuits in the country.

name: Alidoro
dsc: Alidoro's 'The Pinocchio' sandwich is a classic Italian combination that features prosciutto, soppressata, and fresh mozzarella on artisan bread. This 4-pack kit allows you to recreate this delicious sandwich at home. The prosciutto is salty and savory, the soppressata adds a spicy kick, and the mozzarella provides a creamy contrast. Each sandwich is finished with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of oregano. Alidoro has been a New York favorite since 1983.

name: Sarge's Deli
dsc: Sarge's Deli in New York City is famous for its massive sandwiches. This 'Monster Sandwich Kit' for 4 includes their legendary sandwich piled high with corned beef, pastrami, turkey, and Swiss cheese on rye bread. The meats are tender and flavorful, and the sandwich is so large that it requires two hands to hold. Sarge's has been a NYC deli favorite since 1964, known for its generous portions and high-quality meats.

name: Town Hall Deli
dsc: Town Hall Deli's 3-pack of their famous Sloppy Joe sandwiches is perfect for larger gatherings, serving up to 9 people. Each sandwich features layers of corned beef, pastrami, and turkey with coleslaw and Russian dressing on rye bread. This New Jersey classic has been a favorite since 1925 and is known for its perfect balance of flavors and textures. The Sloppy Joe is a must-try for anyone visiting the Garden State.

name: Sam LaGrassa's
dsc: Sam LaGrassa's in Boston is renowned for its gourmet grilled sandwiches. This 4-pack features their most popular specialty sandwiches, each made with premium meats and cheeses on artisan bread. The sandwiches are grilled to perfection, creating a crispy exterior and a warm, melty interior. Sam LaGrassa's has been a Boston favorite since 1968, known for its high-quality ingredients and creative sandwich combinations.

name: Anderson's Frozen Custard
dsc: This combo pack from Anderson's Frozen Custard includes their famous Beef on Weck sandwiches and creamy frozen custard for 4 people. The Beef on Weck features tender roast beef on a kummelweck roll with coarse salt and caraway seeds. The frozen custard is rich, creamy, and the perfect way to end your meal. Anderson's has been a Buffalo institution since 1946, and this combo offers a taste of classic Buffalo dining.

name: Joe's KC BBQ
dsc: Joe's KC BBQ's Z-Man Sandwich is legendary in Kansas City. This 8-pack kit includes everything you need to make this iconic sandwich at home. The Z-Man features tender smoked brisket, melted provolone cheese, and crispy onion rings on a soft Kaiser roll, all served with Joe's sweet-and-tangy BBQ sauce. Joe's KC BBQ has been named one of the best BBQ joints in America, and this sandwich is a big reason why.

name: Pat's King of Steaks
dsc: Pat's King of Steaks is the birthplace of the Philly cheesesteak, serving this iconic sandwich since 1930. This 4-pack includes their original cheesesteaks, made with thinly sliced ribeye steak and melted provolone or Cheez Whiz on a fresh hoagie roll. The steak is perfectly seasoned and cooked to order, creating a sandwich that is both savory and satisfying. Pat's is a Philadelphia landmark that every sandwich lover must try.

name: Bartolini’s
dsc: Bartolini's in Chicago is famous for its Italian meatball sandwiches. This 6-pack kit includes their signature meatballs, made with a blend of beef and pork, and simmered in a rich tomato sauce. The meatballs are piled high on fresh Italian bread and topped with melted provolone cheese. This sandwich is a Chicago favorite that has been satisfying hungry customers for decades. Perfect for a family dinner or a casual gathering.

name: Versailles Restaurant
dsc: Versailles Restaurant in Miami is famous for its authentic Cuban sandwiches. This 4-pack kit includes their signature Cuban sandwich, made with roasted pork, ham, Swiss cheese, pickles, and mustard on crispy Cuban bread. The sandwich is pressed to perfection, creating a warm, crispy exterior and a melty, flavorful interior. Versailles has been a Miami institution since 1971, serving some of the best Cuban food outside of Havana.

name: Kings BBQ
dsc: Kings BBQ's Carolina Pulled Pork Sandwich Pack features their famous hand-chopped pork BBQ, a true taste of North Carolina. The pork is smoked over a wood fire for hours, then hand-chopped to achieve the perfect texture. It's mixed with a vinegar-based sauce that adds a tangy, sharp flavor. This pack includes everything you need to make delicious Carolina-style pulled pork sandwiches at home. Kings BBQ has been a family-owned tradition for generations.

name: Alidoro
dsc: Alidoro's Choose Your Own 4-Pack allows you to customize your Italian sandwich experience. You can select from a variety of premium Italian meats including prosciutto, soppressata, mortadella, and salami, as well as cheeses like fresh mozzarella and provolone. Each sandwich is made on artisan bread with your choice of condiments. This pack is perfect for those who want to explore different flavor combinations. Alidoro has been a New York favorite since 1983.

name: Alidoro
dsc: Alidoro's 'The Matthew' sandwich is a classic Italian combination featuring prosciutto and fresh mozzarella on artisan bread. This 4-pack kit allows you to recreate this simple yet delicious sandwich at home. The prosciutto is thinly sliced and salty, the mozzarella is creamy and mild, and the bread is soft and fresh. Each sandwich is finished with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of salt and pepper. This sandwich is a testament to the beauty of simple, high-quality ingredients.

name: Liebman's Kosher Deli
dsc: Liebman's Kosher Deli in the Bronx is famous for its classic Reuben sandwiches. This kit serves 2-4 people and includes their tender corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and Russian dressing on rye bread. The corned beef is perfectly seasoned and sliced thin, while the sauerkraut adds a tangy crunch. Liebman's has been a New York deli favorite since 1953, known for its traditional Jewish deli offerings.

name: Nick's Kitchen
dsc: Nick's Kitchen in Huntington, Indiana is famous for its pork tenderloin sandwiches. This 4-pack features their signature sandwich, made with a thick, breaded pork tenderloin that is fried until golden and crispy. The tenderloin is served on a soft bun with lettuce, tomato, and onion. This sandwich is a Midwest classic that has been enjoyed since Nick's Kitchen opened in 1908. A true taste of Indiana comfort food.

name: Shaq's Big Chicken
dsc: Shaq's Big Chicken is a Las Vegas favorite created by basketball legend Shaquille O'Neal. This fried chicken sandwich combo kit for 6 includes six crispy fried chicken sandwiches, each served on a soft bun with pickles and their signature sauce. The chicken is juicy, flavorful, and fried to a perfect golden brown. Shaq's Big Chicken brings the flavor of Las Vegas to your kitchen, with sandwiches that are generously portioned and packed with flavor.

name: Chaps Pit Beef
dsc: Chaps Pit Beef in Baltimore is famous for its pit beef sandwiches, a Maryland specialty. This 8-pack kit includes their signature pit beef, which is roasted over an open flame and sliced thin. The beef is tender and smoky, served on a soft roll with horseradish and barbecue sauce. Chaps has been a Baltimore favorite since 1987, known for its authentic pit beef that captures the essence of Maryland barbecue.

name: Campo's Philly Cheesesteaks
dsc: Campo's Philly Cheesesteaks has been a Philadelphia favorite since 1947. This 4-pack of Italian hoagies features a variety of premium meats, including ham, salami, and pepperoni, along with provolone cheese and fresh vegetables on a soft hoagie roll. The hoagie is finished with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of oregano. Campo's is known for its high-quality ingredients and authentic Philly flavors, making these hoagies a must-try.

name: Ugly Drum
dsc: Ugly Drum from Los Angeles offers a unique take on the classic Reuben with their 'Swiss Stack' sandwich kit. This 4-pack features their house-smoked pastrami, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and Russian dressing on rye bread. The pastrami is smoked over a custom wood blend, giving it a rich, smoky flavor. The Swiss cheese adds a creamy contrast, while the sauerkraut provides a tangy crunch. Ugly Drum is known for its bold, authentic flavors.

name: Tony Boloney's
dsc: Tony Boloney's is a Hoboken favorite known for its creative and delicious sub sandwiches. This 10-pack sampler includes a variety of their most popular subs, each featuring premium meats, cheeses, and fresh vegetables on artisanal bread. The sampler includes both classic and unique flavor combinations, offering something for everyone. Tony Boloney's has been serving New Jersey since 2011 and is known for its inventive sandwich creations.

name: White House Subs
dsc: White House Subs in Atlantic City is a legendary sub shop that has been serving delicious sandwiches since 1946. This 'Choose Your Own Subs for 4' pack allows you to customize four subs with your choice of meats, cheeses, and toppings. The subs are made on fresh Italian bread and feature high-quality ingredients. White House Subs is a must-visit for anyone in Atlantic City, and this kit brings that experience to your home.

name: Central Grocery Muffulettas
dsc: Central Grocery's 4-pack of Original Muffuletta sandwiches is the ultimate party pack, serving 14-16 people. Each massive sandwich features their signature Sicilian sesame bread loaded with cured meats, provolone cheese, and their famous olive salad. The olive salad is a tangy, briny mixture of olives, celery, garlic, and spices that has made this sandwich a New Orleans legend. This pack is perfect for large gatherings, parties, and celebrations.

name: Alidoro
dsc: Alidoro's Best Sellers 8-Pack is the ultimate Italian sandwich collection. This pack features eight of their most popular sandwiches, each made with premium Italian meats and cheeses on artisan bread. The variety includes prosciutto, soppressata, mortadella, and salami combinations, paired with fresh mozzarella and flavorful condiments. This pack is perfect for large gatherings, office events, or any occasion where you want to serve authentic Italian sandwiches.

name: Wagshal's
dsc: Wagshal's in Washington, DC is a gourmet market and deli known for its high-quality meats. This Prime Smoked Brisket Sandwich Pack for 2 includes their premium smoked brisket, which is tender, juicy, and full of flavor. The brisket is sliced thin and served on a soft roll with a side of their signature sauce. This pack is perfect for a cozy dinner for two or a quick lunch. Wagshal's has been a DC institution since 1925.

name: Louie Mueller Barbecue
dsc: Louie Mueller Barbecue in Taylor, Texas is a legendary BBQ joint that has been serving since 1949. This Chopped Brisket Sandwich Kit for 8 features their famous smoked brisket, which is chopped and served on soft buns with pickles and onions. The brisket is smoked over post-oak wood, giving it a rich, smoky flavor that is second to none. Louie Mueller is a Texas BBQ institution, and this kit brings their legendary brisket to your home.

name: Pine State Biscuits
dsc: Pine State Biscuits in Portland, Oregon is famous for its Southern-inspired biscuits. 'The Reggie' is their signature sandwich, featuring a fried chicken breast, bacon, and cheese on a flaky buttermilk biscuit, topped with sausage gravy. This 4-pack kit allows you to recreate this Portland favorite at home. Pine State has been serving these delicious biscuits since 2006, and this sandwich is a must-try for any biscuit lover.

name: Tony Boloney's
dsc: Tony Boloney's 'Boloney Rex' is a massive sub sandwich that lives up to its name. This 2-pack includes two of their largest subs, each piled high with a variety of premium meats, cheeses, and fresh vegetables. The subs are made on artisanal bread and are generously portioned. Tony Boloney's is known for its creative and delicious sandwich creations, and the Boloney Rex is one of their most popular offerings.

name: Fedoroff's Roast Pork
dsc: Fedoroff's in Brooklyn offers a delicious combo pack featuring two cheesesteaks and two roast pork sandwiches. The cheesesteaks are made with thinly sliced ribeye and melted cheese on a fresh roll, while the roast pork sandwiches feature slow-roasted pork with provolone and broccoli rabe. This 4-pack is perfect for those who want to try both of these Philadelphia favorites. Fedoroff's is known for its high-quality, authentic sandwiches.

name: Anderson's Frozen Custard
dsc: Anderson's 8-pack of Beef on Weck sandwiches is perfect for large gatherings and parties. Each sandwich features tender roast beef piled high on a kummelweck roll topped with coarse salt and caraway seeds. The beef is slow-roasted to perfection and sliced thin. Anderson's has been serving Buffalo since 1946, and their Beef on Weck is a local favorite. This pack is a great way to share a taste of Buffalo with family and friends.

name: Crescent Moon
dsc: Crescent Moon in Omaha, Nebraska is famous for its Original Blackstone Reuben. This 4-pack kit includes their signature Reuben, featuring tender corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut, and Thousand Island dressing on grilled rye bread. The sandwich is grilled to perfection, creating a warm, crispy exterior and a melty, flavorful interior. Crescent Moon has been serving this Omaha classic since 1934.

name: Cochon Butcher
dsc: Cochon Butcher in New Orleans offers a unique take on the classic muffuletta with their Hot Muffuletta. This 4-pack features their version of the New Orleans classic, made with house-cured meats, provolone cheese, and olive salad on fresh Italian bread. The hot version adds a spicy kick that sets it apart from the traditional muffuletta. Cochon Butcher has been serving New Orleans since 2008 and is known for its high-quality charcuterie.

name: Jim's Steaks
dsc: Jim's Steaks is a Philadelphia institution that has been serving some of the city's best cheesesteaks since 1976. This 4-pack includes their famous cheesesteaks, made with thinly sliced ribeye steak and melted provolone cheese on a fresh hoagie roll. The steak is perfectly seasoned and cooked to order, creating a sandwich that is both savory and satisfying. Jim's is a South Street landmark that every cheesesteak lover must try.

name: Walter's Hot Dogs
dsc: Walter's Hot Dogs is a Mamaroneck, New York institution that has been serving its famous hot dogs since 1919. This 12-pack includes their signature hot dogs, which are grilled to perfection and served on a soft bun with your choice of toppings. The hot dogs are made with a secret family recipe and have a unique flavor that has made Walter's a local legend. This pack is perfect for parties, cookouts, or a classic American meal.

name: Kenny & Ziggy's Delicatessen
dsc: Kenny & Ziggy's Delicatessen in Houston is a New York-style deli known for its massive, delicious sandwiches. This Pastrami Sandwich Kit features their famous pastrami, which is smoked and steamed to perfection, then sliced thin and piled high on rye bread with mustard. The pastrami is tender, juicy, and full of flavor. Kenny & Ziggy's has been serving Houston since 2004 and is a must-visit for any deli lover.

name: Town Hall Deli
dsc: Town Hall Deli's 2-pack of their famous Sloppy Joe sandwiches serves up to 6 people. This New Jersey classic has been a favorite since 1925 and is known for its perfect balance of flavors and textures. This pack is ideal for a family dinner or a small gathering with friends.

name: Millburn Deli

name: Campo's Philly Cheesesteaks
dsc: Campo's Philly Cheesesteaks 6-pack allows you to choose your favorite sandwiches from their extensive menu. Options include classic cheesesteaks, Italian hoagies, and roast pork sandwiches. Each sandwich is made with premium meats and cheeses on fresh bread. Campo's has been a Philadelphia favorite since 1947, known for its high-quality ingredients and authentic Philly flavors. This pack is perfect for parties and events.

The chicken is brined and fried to achieve a perfect balance of crunch and juiciness. This kit is ideal for a picnic, a casual lunch, or a quick dinner. Motel Fried Chicken is known for its creative approach to fried chicken sandwiches.

name: Primanti Bros.
dsc: Primanti Bros. Pastrami Sandwich Pack features their iconic sandwich made with thinly sliced pastrami, melted provolone cheese, and coleslaw on thick Italian bread. The pastrami is tender and flavorful, and the coleslaw adds a refreshing crunch. This sandwich is a Pittsburgh classic that has been served since 1933. This pack is perfect for those who love the unique combination of flavors that Primanti Bros. is famous for.

name: Orwashers Bakery
dsc: Orwashers Bakery's Signature New York Breakfast Sandwich Kit for 6 features their famous bagel sandwiches. Each sandwich includes a freshly baked bagel, eggs, cheese, and your choice of bacon or sausage. The bagels are boiled and baked to perfection, creating a chewy texture and a crisp crust. Orwashers has been a New York institution since 1916, known for its high-quality breads and breakfast sandwiches.

name: Liebman's Kosher Deli
